newsitem.title: UK: UK shares mixed at start, Dow rally lends support.
newsitem.headline: UK shares mixed at start, Dow rally lends support.

text.p: UK shares were mixed at the start of trading on Tuesday, buoyed by a Dow rally but depressed by domestic political woes and a possible U.S. interest rate rise later this month.
The FTSE 100 index was down 2.6 points at 4,370.7 by 0841 GMT, with decliners in a near two-to-one majority. Trading volume was thin at just 26.5 million shares.

Dealers said the market was unlikely to make much progress at the start of the lengthy six-week UK election campaign and with next week's meeting of the Federal Reserve's decision-making committee possibly set to agree a rate hike.
